requests.description: First-round request returns EnterPlanMode, entering plan mode.
requests.syntheticReason: Stably induce plan mode state to avoid relying on whether the real model chooses EnterPlanMode.

requests.description: Return ExitPlanMode within plan mode, triggering the approval dialog.
requests.syntheticReason: Stably trigger the ExitPlanMode approval dialog to prevent the model from outputting text and bypassing the tool.

requests.description: After rejection without feedback, the next regular user input remains in plan mode.
requests.syntheticReason: The core contract is that the provider does not continue the current turn after rejection, but subsequent real user input still carries the plan mode reminder.

requests.description: First-round request for tool boundary case enters plan mode.
requests.syntheticReason: Stably induce plan mode state to avoid relying on whether the real model chooses EnterPlanMode.

requests.description: The same assistant message returns two tool_use calls: Write and Read.
requests.syntheticReason: Prove that rejecting write tools in plan mode does not block the execution of subsequent read-only tools in the same reply.

requests.description: Return pinned text after tool results are fed back into provider-visible requests.
requests.syntheticReason: The core contract is that the provider request contains both write rejection and actual read-only tool results; the reply text only needs to stably wrap up.
